reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertisements are everywhere in our daily life. Some people think this is good, but others think it is bad. In my opinion, advertising has both positive and negative effects.  
On the one hand, advertisements have some benefits. First, they help consumers choose products easily. In the past, people only bought items from local shops, but now TV ads and social media pop-ups show many new products, so people can make better choices. Second, advertising is good for the economy. Good ads make people want to buy more things, which helps companies sell more products. Because of this, companies need more workers, and governments get more tax money.  
On the other hand, advertising also has drawbacks. First, many ads make people waste money. When famous people promote a product, customers like it and buy things they do not really need. Second, too many advertisements make people feel annoyed. For example, when people watch movies or play games on the internet, pop-up ads appear all the time and stop their activities. People often cannot turn off these ads for 30 seconds.  
In conclusion, advertisements are helpful because they give information and support the economy, but they also cause bad spending habits and annoy people.

reviews.question:
The media should include more stories which report good news.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, the media reports many different kinds of news, including both good and bad news. Some people believe that there should be more stories about good news. I partly agree with this opinion because good news can have some benefits, but bad news is also necessary.

On the one hand, good news can help people have a more positive view of life. Today, people often read news about wars, accidents, crimes and natural disasters. Therefore, reading positive stories can make them feel more hopeful and optimistic. For example, Nick Vujicic was born without arms and legs, but he did not give up. He became a famous motivational speaker and travelled around the world to inspire other people. Stories like this can encourage people to face difficulties and continue trying.

On the other hand, I believe that bad news should not be ignored. If the media only reports positive stories, people may not know about serious problems in society. For instance, when people often read news about serious traffic accidents caused by drunk driving, they may become more careful when driving. They can also advise their friends and family not to drink alcohol before driving. In this way, bad news can help people understand real problems and avoid dangerous behaviour.

In conclusion, I partly agree that the media should report more good news because it can make people more positive and motivated. However, bad news is also important because it helps people understand and deal with problems in society.

Tuy nhiên, dàn ý bài này yêu cầu không đồng ý; em lại chọn đồng ý một phần. Body 1 còn thiếu hẳn phần phản biện về thói quen xem tin gây sốc, lượng người đọc và doanh thu của cơ quan báo chí. reviews.suggestedRevision:
The suggestion that news outlets should publish more positive stories has gained attention. I disagree with this proposal because it overlooks practical constraints and the value of reporting distressing events.

Admittedly, more frequent coverage of good news may offer some advantages, but increasing it substantially may be impractical. Positive stories can help people adopt a more optimistic view of the world and life. For example, Nick Vujicic was born without arms and legs, yet he faced many challenges without giving up and became a world-famous motivational speaker who travels to inspire others. However, the proposal fails to consider what audiences choose to read and watch. Many people are drawn to breaking or shocking stories, such as political scandals and natural disasters. If news agencies replace too many such reports with positive stories, they may struggle to attract viewers and readers. This could reduce their revenue and, in extreme cases, lead some agencies to bankruptcy.

Moreover, bad news can benefit the public by warning people about existing and emerging problems in society. For instance, a report on a tragic accident could describe how a family of four lost their lives because the father drove under the influence of alcohol. People repeatedly exposed to such reports may be more likely to avoid drunk driving and to dissuade friends or relatives from doing so. This example shows how reports of deaths caused by dangerous driving can help the public avoid similar harm.

In conclusion, although good news may encourage optimism, I oppose the proposal to publish more of it because doing so could harm news agencies and reduce the warnings people receive about real dangers.

reviews.question:
Some scientists think there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay: It is true that the existence of intelligent life forms on other planets is a topic of debate. While some scientists believe that we should send messages to contact aliens, others think that this action is very dangerous. In my opinion, I completely agree with the second view.   On the one hand, there are some reasons why people want to contact life on other planets. Currently, the Earth is facing many severe problems that seem to be insoluble, such as global warming, rising sea levels, and animal extinction. These environmental issues could eventually lead to the demise of our own race in the future. Therefore, if we can contact alien civilizations that have successfully dealt with such problems, they might pass on their invaluable knowledge to us. This help could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction. For these reasons, it is understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to inhabitants on other planets.   On the other hand, I believe that contacting aliens is a bad idea because it involves huge risks. Firstly, our technology is still insufficiently developed for space exploration, which is clearly seen in our failed attempts to send manned missions to Mars. If a civilization is capable of traveling to Earth, their technology must far exceed ours. Consequently, they would have very little to gain by working and coexisting with humanity, except for using us as their test subjects or slaves. Secondly, humans could easily be invaded by these extraterrestrial beings. With their superior technology, we would be rendered helpless against their possible invasion.   In conclusion, although trying to communicate with aliens might give us useful knowledge to solve current problems, I strongly believe that it is too dangerous. Therefore, we should not attempt to contact them to protect our survival
reviews.overall: Em đã thảo luận cả hai quan điểm, chọn quan điểm thứ hai và triển khai gần đủ các chuỗi ý được giao trong 301 từ. Mở bài lại gọi sự tồn tại của sinh vật ngoài hành tinh là vấn đề tranh luận, trong khi đề tập trung vào việc có nên gửi thông điệp; em cần diễn đạt đúng trọng tâm ấy. Câu đầu Body 1 mới nói có lý do muốn liên hệ, chưa nêu luận điểm chung là việc liên hệ có thể có lợi. Em sửa hai câu này, bỏ khung nêu ý kiến bị lặp và soát lại cụm từ cùng dấu chấm cuối bài.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, video games are very popular among people, especially young people. Some people think that they are useful for entertainment and education, while others believe that they have negative effects. In my opinion, the drawbacks of video games outweigh their benefits.

On the one hand, video games have some advantages. Firstly, they provide entertainment and help people relax after a long day of studying or working. Players can enter a virtual world and enjoy exciting activities, such as racing or fighting. Secondly, video games can help players develop useful skills. For example, they need to think carefully and find good strategies to win. As a result, they can improve their problem-solving and decision-making skills.

However, I believe that video games have more disadvantages. The main problem is that they can be addictive. Many games have scores, rewards and new levels, which encourage players to continue playing for hours. For example, children may spend too much time trying to get higher scores than their friends. This can cause several problems, such as a lack of sleep, eye problems and less physical activity. Moreover, students who spend too much time playing games may not have enough time to do their homework. Therefore, their school results may become worse. Although there are other activities, such as playing sports or joining clubs, that can provide entertainment and improve skills, excessive gaming can be harmful to young people.

In conclusion, although video games offer entertainment and help people develop some skills, I believe their negative effects, especially addiction and health and academic problems, are more serious than their benefits.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ 264 từ, giữ rõ quan điểm hại nhiều hơn lợi và giải thích được việc chơi lâu ảnh hưởng đến sức khỏe, học tập. Tuy nhiên, đoạn lợi ích còn thiếu nét mới lạ của trải nghiệm ảo và kỹ năng làm việc nhóm. Quan trọng hơn, em đưa hoạt động thay thế xuống cuối đoạn tác hại nên chưa phản biện rõ vì sao các lợi ích ấy kém sức nặng. reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, scientists and tourists can travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole. In my opinion, this is a positive development because it provides new experiences for tourists and helps scientists gain useful knowledge.

On the one hand, travelling to remote areas brings many benefits to tourists. Although there are many famous tourist attractions around the world, some people still want to discover new places. For example, they can visit a small island that few people know about. There, they can try local food, learn about traditional customs and see rare plants and animals. These activities help them understand different cultures and enjoy a new way of life. Some people may argue that they can watch travel programmes on TV instead. However, watching videos cannot provide the same experience as visiting these places in person.

On the other hand, travelling to remote areas is also useful for scientists. There are still many things in nature that people do not fully understand. By visiting these places, scientists can study new viruses and learn more about animals and their habitats. For example, some dangerous viruses may appear in remote areas, so scientific research can help people understand how they spread. In addition, scientists can study the effects of global warming on wildlife. This knowledge can help governments prepare for future problems and protect the natural environment.

In conclusion, I believe that allowing scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas is a positive development. Tourists can enjoy new experiences, while scientists can gain important knowledge that helps protect people and nature.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đúng hướng có lợi, đủ 263 từ và chia hai đoạn thân bài theo lợi ích cho du khách và nhà khoa học. Em cũng mượn lời ý xem truyền hình trước khi phản biện bằng trải nghiệm trực tiếp. Tuy nhiên, ví dụ du lịch còn thiếu tập tục tôn giáo bản địa, còn đoạn khoa học chưa nối nghiên cứu với việc ứng phó dịch bệnh và phục hồi nơi sống bị hư hại. Cô yêu cầu em bổ sung đúng các bước này, diễn đạt lại mở bài và thử dùng bị động ở chỗ phù hợp.

However, watching videos cannot provide the same experience as visiting these places in person.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em mượn lời ý đối lập về xem truyền hình và phản biện bằng sự khác biệt với trải nghiệm trực tiếp.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [phản biện nhỏ để kéo dài đoạn - tránh bí ý thiếu từ và tạo điểm nhấn tư duy cho bài luận] Granted, one might say that they can see these things on TV channels dedicated to travel. However, the experience is far inferior to experiencing such activities in person.

studentQuotes: travelling to remote areas is also useful for scientists.
outlineCoverage.comment: Câu chủ đề nêu đúng lợi ích cho nhà khoa học.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 2: [LỢI CHO SCIENTISTS]

studentQuotes: There are still many things in nature that people do not fully understand.
By visiting these places, scientists can study new viruses and learn more about animals and their habitats.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em có khoảng trống kiến thức và hành động khảo sát, nhưng chưa nói rõ nghiên cứu ở những nơi này giúp trả lời vấn đề đang có và có thể xuất hiện sau này.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → regardless of how much we already know about the world - there is still much that is unknown in the field of science → visit such places - give scientists answers to many existing and future problems

studentQuotes: some dangerous viruses may appear in remote areas
scientists can study the effects of global warming on wildlife.
prepare for future problems and protect the natural environment.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em đã nêu virus và nóng lên toàn cầu, song chưa làm rõ đợt bùng phát có thể gây chết người, sinh vật cùng nơi sống ở rừng rậm/biển sâu, cũng như kết quả phục hồi nơi sống bị hư hại.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [ex] see this in the way novel viruses break out every once in a while, and how global warming is affecting lives and habitats of elusive animals in heavily wooded areas and deep under the sea → understand more about such phenomena - far more prepared for potential outbreaks - kill millions in the future + help restore damaged habitats

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: Nowadays, scientists and tourists can travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: Access to isolated natural regions, such as the South Pole, has opened up to both travellers and researchers.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Cô giữ đúng đối tượng của đề nhưng viết lại mệnh đề mở bài bằng danh từ access và cấu trúc khác, thay vì chỉ lặp đề.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: By visiting these places, scientists can study new viruses and learn more about animals and their habitats.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: Likewise, this research can help ensure that damaged habitats are restored.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Cô giữ cụm By visiting... đúng đồng chủ ngữ, dùng can cho kết quả có khả năng xảy ra và chuyển kết quả phục hồi sang bị động để nhấn mạnh nơi sống được tác động.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: This knowledge can help governments prepare for future problems and protect the natural environment.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: For example, new viruses may emerge from time to time, and research into how they spread can help scientists and governments prepare for future outbreaks that might kill millions of people.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Ví dụ virus được nối đến hệ quả cụ thể của nghiên cứu, thay vì dừng ở 'future problems' chung chung.
